title: jonesiella praelonga
intro: Jonesiella praelonga, commonly known as "Malaysian Kratom", is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing pain, anxiety, and stress, as well as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine, that interact with opioid receptors in the brain to produce analgesic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Jonesiella praelonga may also exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, although further research is needed to confirm these findings.
